pages.name: pages
pages.label: Pages
pages.description: Standalone pages such as About us, Services or Contact.

id.label: ID
id.description: One part of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as about-us: the page's URL is then /about-us/.

template.label: Template
template.description: A list page shows its collection below the content. Its ID must be the collection's: news for News, projects for Projects.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: The short line above the title.

intro.label: Introduction
intro.description: Short lead paragraph shown below the page title.

projects.name: projects
projects.label: Projects
projects.description: Client projects shown in the portfolio.

code.label: Project number
code.patternMessage: Use two capital letters, a hyphen and three digits, like HL-104.

gallery.label: Images
gallery.description: The first image is used as the preview.

sector.label: Sector
sector.description: The client's economic sector, from the NACE list.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.description: Files that visitors can download, such as a case study.

relatedProject.label: Related project
relatedProject.description: The article links to this project's page.

events.name: events
events.label: Events
events.description: Workshops and talks, in person or online.

general.name: general
general.label: General
general.description: Company details, contact information and default SEO.

titleSuffix.label: Title suffix
titleSuffix.description: Appended to every page title, e.g. " — Harbor Lane Consulting".

siteId.label: Site ID
siteId.description: The script address is in the website's code, not here.

homePage.name: homePage
homePage.label: Home page
homePage.description: The texts of the home page. Its title and introduction are the tagline and the description in General.

href.label: Link
href.description: An address on this website, like /contact/.

general.label: On every page
general.description: In the header, and for screen readers.

skipLink.label: Skip link
skipLink.description: The first link of each page, for keyboard users.

menu.label: Menu button
menu.description: On small screens. Only screen readers read it.

tags.label: Name of a list of tags

en.label: Name of a list of tags (EN)

de.label: Name of a list of tags (DE)

de-ch.label: Name of a list of tags (DE-CH)

footer.label: Footer

projects.label: Projects
projects.description: On the list of projects and on each project's page.

allLink.label: Link to the list
allLink.description: On the home page and on each project, like “All projects”.

noImage.label: Text without an image
noImage.description: On a project's card that has no image.

categories.label: Names of the categories
categories.description: As the website shows them. The editor shows the names of the Category field.

news.label: News
news.description: On the list of news and on each article.

allLink.label: Link to the list
allLink.description: On the home page and on each article, like “All news”.

events.label: Events
events.description: On the list of events and on each event's page.

allLink.label: Link to the list
allLink.description: On the home page and on each event, like “All events”.

until.label: Until
until.description: Between the start and the end.

formats.label: Names of the formats
formats.description: As the website shows them. The editor shows the names of the Format field.

and.label: And
and.description: Between two formats, like “In person and Online”.

map.label: Name of the map
map.description: Before the venue's name. Only screen readers read it.

team.label: Team
team.description: On the list of the team and on each person's page.

notFound.label: Page not found
